description: ICP inlier RMSE (mm) per experiment, for the accuracy/F1 summary table.
metric: open3d registration_icp inlier_rmse at the final coarse-to-fine threshold (voxel_size * 0.2), where voxel_size = target bbox diagonal * 0.01

provenance_legend.recomputed: report.json/transform.txt were 0 bytes; recomputed read-only from the original source with the transform recovered from point-wise correspondence (residual ~1e-7 m). Procedure validated by reproducing all 15 stored values to 0.000 mm.
provenance_legend.approximate: pre-registration source not on disk; value from downsampling the aligned cloud. Fallback error measured at <=0.105 mm on comparable VGGT rows with a known true value.

note_flashlight: flashlight registrations were run against data/lidar/flashlight_001/... while the site's accuracy metrics use flashlight_003 (genuinely different files). RMSE here describes the registration as performed, so flashlight_001 is used for all four rows.
